input: Find a local pottery class to join

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing their location or neighbourhood is essential to surfacing relevant, nearby options.
Pottery covers wheel-throwing, hand-building, glazing, and more — knowing which style they want narrows the search significantly.
Their availability (evenings, weekends, specific days) determines which class schedules are even viable.
Class costs vary widely — a hard budget limit rules out studios or multi-week courses that exceed it.
Whether this is just for them, for them and a partner, or for a group affects class type (private, group, workshop) and booking.
Their goal (casual social hobby vs. building a serious skill) shapes what 'a good class' actually looks like — drop-in vs. structured course.
Preferred class format and environment (large studio, small intimate group, beginner-only) reflects comfort and learning style.

gold.taskTitle: Find and join a local pottery class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and sign up for a pottery class in their area.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood are you based in?
questions.description: Identifies the user's location to surface geographically relevant pottery studios and classes.

questions.title: Which pottery style interests you most — wheel or hand-building?
questions.description: Determines the specific type of pottery the user wants to learn, since not all studios offer every technique.

questions.title: Which days or times are you generally free to attend?
questions.description: Pins down the user's weekly availability so only classes with compatible schedules are considered.

questions.title: What is your budget per class or per course?
questions.description: Sets a spending limit to filter out studios or programmes that fall outside the user's financial range.

questions.title: Will you be attending solo or bringing someone along?
questions.description: Clarifies whether booking needs to accommodate one person or multiple, and whether a group class or private session is more appropriate.

questions.title: Is this a casual hobby or do you want structured skill progression?
questions.description: Distinguishes between drop-in social sessions and multi-week courses with progressive instruction, which are very different offerings.

questions.title: Do you prefer a small intimate class or a larger studio setting?
questions.description: Captures the user's comfort and learning-style preferences to match them with the right studio environment.
